One day, while out shopping in the 
commercial district……

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo! I bought way too much merch! 
Whatever should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:

Whatever should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What a coincidence! Actually, we're 
having a night party today!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've been super excited and pumped since 
this morning! I bought tons of merch! But—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Look at that, pleeease! Our usual street 
is packed with people! What a huge mess it 
is!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Taking a detour would cost precious time, 
though... Hrrm! Should I stick to the 
usual route after all?
